title: Census output (F5 Phase 3 contract)
$comment: THE CENSUS PRODUCES FACTS. A fact is a function from a declared key to a measured
value, plus the evidence that produced it. It never produces diagnostics, gate
findings, policy decisions or localization judgments.
The admission test for any new `kind`: can it be named without naming a gate, and
can its value be recomputed from the corpus alone? `marker-lexicon` and
`phrase-count` pass. A `seam-baseline` fails the first; a `licensed-phrase` fails
This schema declares BOTH v1 kinds. F5 Phase 4 implements only `phrase-count`;
`marker-lexicon` is blocked on the manifest `state` migration, because deriving a
marker lexicon from a corpus that has not been reviewed self-excludes the tokens of
the defects already in it. Declaring the full contract while shipping one producer
follows the manifest precedent (schema complete, instance minimal) — the schema is a
contract, and a contract that grows per implementation is not one.
UNKNOWN KEYS ARE REJECTED, NOT IGNORED, everywhere. A typo'd key that silently does
nothing is the `nonBoundaries` defect (F2 M-4) reproduced in the contract layer.

censusVersion.$comment: The OUTPUT SCHEMA version. Refused forward and backward — an engine that guesses at an unknown version applies the wrong contract silently. Distinct from the per-fact `extractor` version and from the corpus fingerprint; see the three axes in F5-census-contract.md §9.

measuredAt.$comment: An explicit argument, never a wall clock. A census that embeds Date.now() cannot be diffed, and diffing regenerated output against committed output is the only review method that scales.

manifest.$comment: Hash of the CANONICALIZED manifest object, not of the file bytes: the contract is what was resolved, not how it was formatted.

pages.$comment: Pages walked, per locale. Locales with no rendered pages are absent rather than zero — the census reports what it measured.

facts.$comment: Sorted by kind, then by key, in code-unit order. Determinism is the contract: same corpus + same manifest + same census version => byte-identical output.

extractor.$comment: The render-index view that produced the value, versioned. PER FACT, not per file: a phrase-count from visibleText@1 and a marker-lexicon from headings@1 go stale under different conditions. A value whose extractor version the engine does not recognize cannot be compared and is exit 2.

value.$comment: Non-overlapping occurrences across the locale's rendered pages. UNMASKED: which compounds license a term is a decision, applied by the consumer at read time. If a masked baseline is ever needed, the mask set joins the KEY — it must never become an unkeyed transformation of the value.

markerLexicon.$comment: Declared, not yet produced. Blocked on the manifest `state` migration (F5-census-contract.md §10 F-1).
